description: This file defines a service for aggregating LLM (Large Language Model) costs by agent name, including functions for resolving collection names, building MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different data schemas, and a fallback in-process aggregation method. It exports functions to retrieve aggregated costs and handle various data schemas and errors.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates
methods.description: Determines collection names from environment variables and defaults, prioritizing 'llm-costs' and other common collection names.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with flat schema, normalizing agent names and summing costs in USD.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with an Agents[] array schema, normalizing agent names and summing costs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp
methods.description: In-process fallback to aggregate agent costs from an array of documents, preserving display casing and rounding to 6 decimals.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to retrieve aggregated LLM costs by agent from the database, with fallback to in-process aggregation if needed.
